items.q: along with the fact that I started playing in the orchestra with Bunk Johnson

ctx.x: But the point is when I mentioned the fact that I had accompanied her, he said, 'Oh, you did? You mean to tell me --,' I said, 'Yes, I did.' 'My God,' he says, 'That's wonderful. That's wonderful.' So that, of course along with the fact that I started playing in the orchestra with Bunk Johnson, well that was something else that was really of great importance to my career.
